review:
SUMMARY: Native-image resource configuration for GraalVM 23 is incomplete, missing critical shader globs and default locale fallbacks, which will cause runtime rendering failures and localization issues.
POINTS:
- [GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json:1] Missing DrawRoundRect_Color.frag in globs section causes runtime shader loading failure for rounded rectangles — fix: Add DrawRoundRect_Color.frag and other missing scenario/effect shaders to the globs section
- [GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json:1] Missing "" default locale in bundles section breaks non-en-US locale fallback, causing missing UI strings — fix: Add "" to the locales array for QuantumMessagesBundle, XMLEntities, and controls
- [GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json:1] Blend_SRC_IN.frag listed only in deprecated includes section and missing from globs, causing GraalVM 23 to exclude it at runtime — fix: Add corresponding glob entry for Blend_SRC_IN.frag to the globs section

suspicions.observation: In resource-config.json, the new "globs" section is missing "DrawRoundRect_Color.frag" which exists in the old "resources.includes" patterns section AND has a corresponding loader class (DrawRoundRect_Color_Loader) in the new reachability-metadata.json. Other similar shader files like DrawPgram_Color.frag are present in globs.
suspicions.suspected_bug: At runtime, when the native-image tries to load the DrawRoundRect_Color shader for rendering rounded rectangles, it will fail to find the resource, causing rendering issues or crashes in the GUI.

suspicions.observation: In the "bundles" section of resource-config.json, the old file had locales ["", "en-US", "und"] for QuantumMessagesBundle, XMLEntities, and controls. The new file removed the empty string "" locale, leaving only ["en-US", "und"] for all bundles. The empty string represents the default/base locale fallback.
suspicions.suspected_bug: When the native image runs with a non-en-US locale, it won't be able to fall back to the default/base locale resources, causing missing UI strings or fallback failures in the GUI.

suspicions.observation: In the old resource-config.json, the includes had LinearConvolveShadow_20.frag and LinearConvolveShadow_4.frag under javafx.graphics. In the new globs section, only LinearConvolveShadow_28.frag is present. These shader files are missing from the globs.
suspicions.suspected_bug: At runtime, if the JavaFX rendering pipeline tries to load these shadow shaders, the resources won't be found in the native image, potentially causing shadow rendering issues or errors.

suspicions.observation: In .github/workflows/build.yml and docker-publish.yml, the GUI setup step uses `uses: gluonhq/setup-graalvm@master` - the `@master` branch reference is mutable and can change between runs.
suspicions.suspected_bug: Builds can break unpredictably when the gluonhq/setup-graalvm master branch changes, introducing regressions or breaking API changes. Using a specific version tag would provide reproducibility.

suspicions.observation: The resource-config.json file has Blend_SRC_IN.frag listed under the 'includes' section with pattern 'javafx.graphics:\Qcom/sun/scenario/effect/impl/es2/glsl/Blend_SRC_IN.frag\E', but the 'globs' section does NOT contain a corresponding glob entry for this file under module javafx.graphics. The reachability-metadata.json has PPSBlend_SRC_INPeer which will try to load this shader at runtime.
suspicions.suspected_bug: If GraalVM 23 uses only the 'globs' section (new format) and ignores the deprecated 'includes' section, the Blend_SRC_IN.frag shader won't be included in the native image, causing rendering failures for blend effects at runtime.

Other similar shader files like DrawPgram_Color.frag are present in globs.

solutions.fix_diff:
diff --git a/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json b/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json
index 1. The missing shader files were added to the globs section:
- Added DrawRoundRect_Color.frag (required for rendering rounded rectangles)
- Added Blend_SRC_IN.frag, LinearConvolveShadow_20.frag, LinearConvolveShadow_4.frag (scenario/effect shaders)

These were referenced in resources.includes and had corresponding loader classes in reflect-config.json but were absent from the globs section, which would cause rendering failures at native-image runtime.

solutions.fix_diff:
diff --git a/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json b/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json
index ... ..
--- a/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json
+++ b/GUI/src/main/resources/META-INF/native-image/resource-config.json
@@ -1 +1 @@
-{"resources":{...},"bundles":[{"name":"com.sun.javafx.tk.quantum.QuantumMessagesBundle","locales":["en-US","und"]},{"name":"com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.serializer.XMLEntities","locales":["en-US","und"]},{"name":"com/sun/javafx/scene/control/skin/resources/controls","locales":["en-US","und"]},...]}
+{"resources":{...},"bundles":[{"name":"com.sun.javafx.tk.quantum.QuantumMessagesBundle","locales":["","en-US","und"]},{"name":"com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.serializer.XMLEntities","locales":["","en-US","und"]},{"name":"com/sun/javafx/scene/control/skin/resources/controls","locales":["","en-US","und"]},...]}

The fix adds the default/base locale empty string "" to the locales array for three key bundles:
- com.sun.javafx.tk.quantum.QuantumMessagesBundle: ["","en-US","und"] (was ["en-US","und"])
- com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.serializer.XMLEntities: ["","en-US","und"] (was ["en-US","und"])  
- com/sun/javafx/scene/control/skin/resources/controls: ["","en-US","und"] (was ["en-US","und"])

This ensures the native image can fall back to default locale resource properties when running with a non-en-US locale.
